finding.title: Path traversal in Notes.read
finding.description: A name containing '../' is joined to the root directory without confinement, so Notes.read can read a file outside that directory.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (name '../secret.txt', which names secret.txt beside, not inside, the notes root. Setup: Create a temporary directory holding a notes root; write 'milk' to todo.txt inside the root and 'top secret' to secret.txt in the parent directory, beside the root) reaches Notes.read without confinement or encoding, then: Returns 'top secret', the content of secret.txt outside the root, so the read escapes the notes root (an unaffected implementation returns no content)

control.seam: Call the real Notes.read through its public interface
control.input_description: name 'todo.txt' for a note inside the notes root. Setup: Create a temporary directory holding a notes root; write 'milk' to todo.txt inside the root and 'top secret' to secret.txt in the parent directory, beside the root
control.property_to_assert: Returns 'milk', the content of todo.txt inside the root

exploit.seam: Call the real Notes.read through its public interface
exploit.input_description: name '../secret.txt', which names secret.txt beside, not inside, the notes root. Setup: Create a temporary directory holding a notes root; write 'milk' to todo.txt inside the root and 'top secret' to secret.txt in the parent directory, beside the root
exploit.property_to_assert: Returns 'top secret', the content of secret.txt outside the root, so the read escapes the notes root (an unaffected implementation returns no content)
